column1: # Stress of words that are NOT milra (milra = stress on the last syllable is the default).
# Every word of the built-in content was reviewed by hand; build_speech.py writes review/words.tsv.
# <word> TAB <stressed syllable counted from the end: 2 = mil'el, 3 = the one before, 1 = milra>
#   - without nikud: matches by letters, also after prefix letters (ו ה ב כ ל מ ש)
#   - with nikud: only that vocalized form (homographs), also after prefixes
#   - several words with nikud: the stress of the last word in that phrase only
#   - a value /like this/ gives the phonemes directly
# Automatic (no entry needed): segolates and present feminine (כֶּלֶב, בֹּקֶר, הוֹלֶכֶת), -ַיִם/-ַיִת
# (מַיִם, בַּיִת), -ֶיהָ (עָלֶיהָ) and the past -תָּ (הִצְלַחְתָּ). An entry with 1 overrides them.
# --- names (as said in everyday Israeli speech)
# --- verbs: past tense with the stress before the ending
